patch_description: This redesign uses a modular candidate pipeline: input-aware C4-free repair, cost-aware saturation, and bounded edge-removal/refill swaps. Rather than recomputing only degree-based greedy choices, saturation estimates how many currently legal future edges an insertion would block using the length-three-path characterization. Multiple repaired subgraphs are built from different input-dependent retention orders, then improved with temporary banned-edge swap searches. Every construction phase preserves the C4-free invariant, and a final explicit verification/repair is retained defensively.
